title: Chevrolet Corvette 1984-2007 official exterior color audit
scope: Model years 1984 through 2007. Complete retained official body paint charts are transcribed by exact source scope. Special editions, two tone programs, convertible tops, stripes, revision conflicts, partial notices, and missing source years remain separate.
methodology: Use only retained official General Motors Heritage Vehicle Information Kit artifacts listed in data/sources/gm-heritage-chevrolet-artifacts.json.
Review each complete exterior body paint chart and preserve each model, body style, special edition, two tone, top, stripe, and revision scope separately.
Do not infer unchanged colors or codes from adjacent model years.
Preserve literal printed labels and codes. Record handwritten, narrative only, crossed out, and missing code evidence without promoting it.
Verify retained renders where present and state when only retained text extraction was available.
Check the public brochure-source-archive-v1 GitHub release and distinguish planned archive links from live assets.
archive_note: The official GM URLs and artifact metadata are verified. The 1984 through 2006 Corvette artifacts were not present in the public brochure-source-archive-v1 release when checked on 2026-08-07. Each source therefore records a null archive_url and a deterministic planned_archive_url without claiming that the planned link is live. No 2007 Corvette artifact exists in the retained official source ledger.
